questions.q: What is the relationship between ITIL 4 and a platform like ServiceNow?
options: ITIL 4 is a framework describing what practices should do; a platform like ServiceNow is software that executes those practices with workflow, automation, and a shared data model
ServiceNow is itself an ITIL 4 practice
ITIL 4 requires every organization to use ServiceNow specifically
Platforms like ServiceNow replace the need for any ITIL 4 practice definitions
questions.explain: ITIL 4 stays deliberately silent on 'how' — a platform is one way organizations execute the practices day to day.

questions.q: Which ITIL 4 practice does ServiceNow's "Change Management" module implement?
options: Continual improvement
Change enablement
Incident management
Service level management
questions.explain: ServiceNow literally names its module "Change Management," but it's implementing the ITIL 4 practice called change enablement.

questions.q: What does the CMDB (Configuration Management Database) do in ServiceNow?
options: It only stores agent login credentials
It only tracks SLA breach timers
It maps configuration items and their relationships, implementing the service configuration management practice
It replaces the need for a Service Catalog
questions.explain: The CMDB is the structured map of configuration items and dependencies underneath incident, problem, and change records.

questions.q: What is the Service Catalog, and which ITIL 4 practice does it support?
options: A list of known errors supporting problem management
An archive of closed incidents
The CMDB's visual interface
A browsable list of orderable items (like a new laptop or software license) supporting service request management
questions.explain: Request Management is built on the Service Catalog, turning generic tickets into fulfillable, browsable request items.

questions.q: How does ServiceNow's service desk experience differ between IT staff and end users?
options: Agents and end users use the exact same interface with no differences
End users have no way to interact with the platform at all
The Agent Workspace serves IT staff resolving tickets, while the Employee/Service Portal serves end users submitting and tracking requests
Only the Agent Workspace exists; there is no self-service option
questions.explain: Same underlying records, but two purpose-built experiences split by audience.
